purpose: Held-out comparison against a future DeepSeek extraction of this exact frozen source; not an extraction input or adopted financial dataset.

steps: Read the frozen source metadata and verify raw-file SHA-256.
Inspect the consolidated statements and selected table rows in their original column order.
Cross-check the same raw-HTML rows against issuer-scoped inline fact IDs, units and actual contexts.
Record reviewer-selected answers separately; preserve table headings, signs and stock/flow distinctions.
method.isolation: This artifact must never be supplied to a planner, extraction model, normalization logic, or extraction runner. Use only after extraction for review/comparison.

coverage.company_scope: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. and consolidated subsidiaries
coverage.core_financial_package: selected lines verified; not a full statement or full-note audit
coverage.comparative_year_policy: FY2022 and FY2021 values are comparative columns in this FY2023 filing; no separate earlier filing was inspected.
reviewed_source_sections: Selected core rows of the three consolidated primary statements, reported pages 54, 56 and 58.
Fiscal-year paragraph in Note 2, reported page 60, solely for exact fiscal-calendar confirmation.
Supplemental cash-flow accrued-but-unpaid PPE row, reported page 59, solely to distinguish it from cash capex.
not_reviewed: Debt note principal values, maturity schedules and lease-inclusive debt definitions.
All other notes, segments, comprehensive income and stockholders equity statement.
FY2021 balance-sheet debt, capital stock and period-end share quantities; not asserted from the reviewed primary balance sheet.
Actual precision beyond statement-rounded millions, forecasts, valuation, investment judgments, and later restatements.

fiscal_calendar.source_text: Fiscal Year. The Company uses a 52- or 53-week fiscal year ending on the last Saturday in December. Fiscal 2023, 2022 and 2021 ended on December 30, 2023, December 31, 2022 and December 25, 2021, respectively. Fiscal 2023 and 2021 each consisted of 52 weeks, while fiscal 2022 consisted of 53 weeks.
fiscal_calendar.constraint: Do not convert these to calendar-year January 1 through December 31 intervals.

review_cautions: USD amount of common stock is distinct from common shares issued/outstanding and total stockholders equity.
Basic/diluted weighted-average shares are duration facts, not period-end outstanding shares.
Cash and cash equivalents exclude separately presented short-term investments; no combined cash-plus-investments metric was inferred.
The current debt line is explicitly labelled Current portion of long-term debt, net even though its inline concept is ShortTermBorrowings.
